desc: R-IPPO on URB -- the memory arm. paper/BASELINES.md B2.
Host block == ippo/config1.json: the ONLY difference from URB's IPPO is
the GRU, which is the point of the arm.
(10 and 1). The GRU layer is onpolicy/algorithms/utils/rnn.py:
nn.GRU with orthogonal weights and zero biases, then LayerNorm.
The hidden state is carried across DAYS and is never reset; see
CHECKLIST_rippo.md item SEQ-1 for why a per-episode reset would make
this arm numerically identical to plain IPPO.
